How can I eliminate unnecessary re-renders in React 19? Here is my component code:

SlowComponent.tsx

In React 19, the React Compiler automatically memoizes components, but manual optimization is still helpful for complex calculations:

import { useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';

export function OptimizedList({ items, onSelect }: { items: string[]; onSelect: (item: string) => void }) {
  const filtered = useMemo(() => items.filter(Boolean), [items]);
  const handleSelect = useCallback((item: string) => onSelect(item), [onSelect]);

  return (
    <ul>
      {filtered.map((item) => (
        <li key={item} onClick={() => handleSelect(item)}>{item}</li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}
Hook Use Case
useMemo Expensive computations
useCallback Stable callback references
